The csv file Neuropathic_3.csv contains neuropathic pain diagnosis records in the form of tables of which the row represents different patients and the column represents different diagnostic labels.

Which cause-and-effect relationship is more likely?
A. L chest disorders causes L eye problems
B. L eye problems causes L chest disorders
C. No causal relationship exists
Please answer with A, B, or C.

a

content.text:
In this dataset "L chest disorders" is 0 for every patient, so it has no variation. That means no association with "L eye problems" can be measured, and the data show no causal link between the two. The eye-problem column correlates only with the cervical C2 radiculopathy columns and the craniocervical junction column, which are separate causes of the eye problems rather than a link to chest disorders.

ANSWER: C
